description: A support-ticket triage board built on the Svelte 5 data grid with two styling hooks. rowClass adds row-level state classes for SLA breach, at-risk and done, rendered as a thin accent strip on the leftmost cell; cellClass paints priority pills, status badges, plan badges, an agent-load bar and CSAT highlights per column. The look stays tonal with low-saturation backgrounds and tabular numerals, and pagination keeps the queue at twenty rows.

faq.question: How do I style a whole row based on its data?
faq.answer: Pass rowClass={({ row }) => ...} on <SvGrid>. Return one or more class names computed from the row, here breach, risk or done from the SLA due date, and style them in your CSS.

faq.question: How do I style a single column's cells?
faq.answer: Set cellClass on the column definition; it receives the cell context and returns a class. The priority, status and plan columns use it for pills and badges without any snippet.

faq.question: When should I use a cell snippet instead?
faq.answer: When the cell needs markup beyond a class, such as the agent-load progress bar here. Classes cover colours and typography; snippets cover structure.
